components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action. Rose tally-light on Aurora Day; remaps with --tn-primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 1rem; border: none; border-radius: 4px; background: rgb(var(--tn-primary)); color: rgb(var(--fnt-active)); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, rgb(var(--tn-primary)) 90%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(var(--tn-primary)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet panel action on card fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 1rem; border: none; border-radius: 4px; background: rgb(var(--bg-secondary)); color: rgb(var(--fnt-primary)); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgb(var(--bg-tertiary)); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(var(--tn-primary)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Icon and tertiary chrome hits in HeaderBar / MainBar.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 1rem; border: none; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: rgb(var(--fnt-primary)); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, rgb(var(--bg-tertiary)) 70%, transparent); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(var(--tn-primary)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Bordered alternative when fill would compete with the board.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 1rem; border: 1px solid rgb(var(--tn-border)); border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: rgb(var(--fnt-primary)); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, rgb(var(--bg-tertiary)) 70%, transparent); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(var(--tn-primary)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Soft Input
components.description: Default PIXIS field: card fill, rounded-md, focus border.
components.css: .ds-input-soft { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; background: rgb(var(--bg-secondary)); color: rgb(var(--fnt-primary)); } .ds-input-soft:focus-within { border-color: rgb(var(--tn-border)); } .ds-input-soft input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; font-size: 0.875rem; outline: none; } .ds-input-soft input::placeholder { color: rgb(var(--fnt-secondary)); }

components.name: Default Chip
components.description: Compact filter/tag. Primary chip uses rose wash, not a second button.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 1.75rem; padding: 0 0.5rem; border: 1px solid rgb(var(--tn-border)); border-radius: 4px; background: color-mix(in srgb, rgb(var(--bg-tertiary)) 50%, transparent); color: rgb(var(--fnt-primary)); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Studio Tooltip
components.description: Icon-button helper copy. Card fill, rose-tinted border.
components.css: .ds-tooltip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; max-width: 20rem; padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, rgb(var(--tn-primary)) 30%, transparent); border-radius: 4px; background: rgb(var(--bg-secondary)); color: rgb(var(--fnt-primary)); font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.25rem; }

narrative.overview:
PIXIS chrome is a quiet workbench around a loud artifact. The board — a Monaco snippet or a picture canvas — is the photograph. Header, detail bar, main bar, and popups are the console: dense, tokenized, and willing to disappear when a theme swap repaints every semantic slot.

The default look is cool pale paper with a rose accent used like a recording-studio tally light: present, rare, never a wash. Users can replace the entire palette (`THEMES` in `src/app/defaults/themes.ts`); the system is the token graph, not a single hex. SSR `:root` is a near-black fallback until the persisted theme hydrates — do not treat that dark fallback as the brand.
keyCharacteristics: Semantic CSS variables (`bg-primary`, `tn-primary`, `gap-grid`, `rounded-radius`) are the only legal color/space/radius source for new UI.
Display type (Plus Jakarta Sans) for titles; Geist Sans for body and controls.
Soft, 4px radii on actions, fields, and chips. `rounded-full` only for switch tracks/thumbs.
Tonal layering for depth; shadows reserved for floating layers.
Studio is full-viewport; the composed shot, not the marketing shell, sets the mood.

rules.name: The Semantic Slot Rule
rules.body: Paint with Tailwind theme utilities (`bg-primary`, `text-foreground`, `border-border`, `bg-card`) or `rgb(var(--token))`. Never introduce `rpx-*` tokens, hardcoded hex in new product UI, or a second palette that ignores `data-theme`.

rules.name: The Tally-Light Rule
rules.body: Rose (or whichever `--tn-primary` the active theme provides) occupies a small fraction of chrome. The board may be vivid; the console stays tonal.

rules.name: The Type-Scale Rule
rules.body: Use `text-xs` … `text-xl` / `Typography` `size`. Do not invent fixed `px` font sizes in product UI.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows are a response to floating (popover, menu), never a default on cards or bars.

rules.name: The No-Glow-Chrome Rule
rules.body: Glow, gradient text, and heavy shadows are for the composed shot (lights, vignette, board). Chrome uses borders and tonal fills.

dos: Do use `bg-primary`, `text-foreground`, `rounded-radius`, `gap-grid` (and siblings) for new chrome.
Do put titles on `font-display` / `Typography.Title|Subtitle|Heading` and body on Geist / `text-sm`.
Do keep Operate density: compact controls, Spanish labels, tooltips on icon-only hits.
Do treat image-studio canvas effects (vignette, lights, 3D) as the artifact; keep chrome quieter than the board.
Do honor `APP_Z_INDEX` instead of inventing new stacking numbers.
donts: Don't hardcode a palette that breaks when the user leaves Aurora Day.
Don't put glow shadows, gradient text, or glassmorphism on studio chrome.
Don't use arbitrary `px` type or `rounded-[var(--radius)]` / `bg-[rgb(var(--…))]` when a theme utility exists.
Don't import domain stores into ShotEditor or fork a second design language for code-studio vs image-studio.
Don't fabricate testimonials, customers, or brand photography.
